Plain text where you want it, and a few handy additions.

- **Plain text where you want it.** Settings → General lists the apps that always get plain text when encore pastes into them, as ⇧↩ does: Terminal, a chat or a code editor get no fonts, colors or links.
- **Merge into one copy.** Right-click a selection: its copies become one new copy, in selection order, one per line, ready to keep as a snippet or a favorite. Detected secrets stay out.
- **Colors in other formats.** A color copied as HEX, `rgb()`, `hsl()` or SwiftUI now shows as a color, swatch included. Right-click it for its other forms: each one becomes a copy, ready to paste.
- **More snippet placeholders.** `{{uuid}}` adds a unique identifier, and `{{date:dd/MM/yyyy}}` or `{{time:HH:mm}}` take your own format.
- **Pause from the footer.** A pause button sits next to the shelf and compact switch: 5 minutes, 1 hour, until resumed, or a duration of your own, also offered by the menu bar icon. While paused, the time left counts down beside it, and one click resumes. ⌘P now pauses and resumes from the shelf, in place of ⌘T.

Download the ZIP, unzip, and move Encore.app to Applications. SHA256SUMS contains its checksum. Installed copies update themselves.

encore is not notarized yet. [Apple's first-launch instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445). History encryption is optional and off by default; exports are not encrypted; files are references; embedded payloads are limited to 25 MiB.
